# github-token negatives: no non-comment line holds a hit.
too short: ghp_123456789abcdefghijABCDEFGHIJklmnop
unknown prefix: ghx_0123456789abcdefghijABCDEFGHIJklmnop
inside a word: xghp_0123456789abcdefghijABCDEFGHIJklmnop
upper-case prefix: GHP_0123456789abcdefghijABCDEFGHIJklmnop
split by a dash: ghp_0123456789abcdefgh-ijABCDEFGHIJklmnop
pat too short: github_pat_0123456789ABCDEFGHIJk
bare prefixes: ghp_ github_pat_ ghs_
